peter1.5.p1.b1.text: As a fellow elder, a witness of Christ’s sufferings, and a partaker of the glory to be revealed, I appeal to the elders among you:

peter1.5.p1.b2.text: Be shepherds of God’s flock that is among you, watching over them not out of compulsion, but because it is God’s will; … not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.

peter1.5.p1.b3.text: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.

peter1.5.p2.b1.text: Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, …

peter1.5.p2.b2.text: … because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.

peter1.5.p2.b3.text: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.

peter1.5.p3.b1.text: Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.

peter1.5.p3.b2.text: Resist him, standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering.

peter1.5.p3.b3.text: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.

peter1.5.p3.b4.text: To Him be the power forever and ever. Amen.

peter1.5.p4.b1.text: Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, … Stand firm in it.

peter1.5.p4.b2.text: The church in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings, as does my son Mark.

peter1.5.p4.b3.text: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
